{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Floor-length wrap-front dress with a V-neckline, soft flutter sleeves and a gently flared A-line skirt, in deep emerald (#0B6B50), matte silk crepe-satin with a fluid drape

Block-heel sandals with an ankle strap, 7 cm heel, in soft gold (#C9A24D), smooth metallic leather

Structured envelope clutch in champagne gold (#D9BF85), silk satin with a hidden clasp

Sculptural drop earrings in polished gold (#D4AF37), gold-plated brass, medium length

Slim cuff bracelet in polished gold (#D4AF37), gold-plated brass

Why this outfit works: the formal-length silk dress meets the dress code for a close family member, and the wrap front with a flared skirt moves easily from the outdoor ceremony to the restaurant dinner. Deep emerald is rich against your warm deep skin, dark hair and brown eyes, and it stays clear of white and ivory, which belong to the bride. The silk crepe-satin breathes in August warmth, and the flutter sleeves keep your arms covered from the sun without the need for a wrap. Block heels are steadier than stilettos on grass, and the gold accents lift the look for the 16:00 light and the evening."}
